title: rorippa palustris var. glabra
intro: Rorippa palustris var. glabra, commonly known as the smooth watercress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its edible leaves and roots, which have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits. The leaves and roots of Rorippa palustris var. glabra contain various bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glucosinolates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of this plant include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system due to its therapeutic actions.
